label_intersections.rule: every pair of label boxes separated by >= 4 px

label_point_coverage.rule: no label box may cover a marker other than its own (clearance >= marker radius + 6 px)

leader_required.rule: labels farther than 24 px from their marker must carry a leader line

line_through_label.rule: no leader segment may enter any label box or any annotation text box

line_wrong_point.rule: a leader must not pass within (marker radius + 5 px) of a marker it does not belong to

line_crossings.rule: at most 3 leader/leader crossings; no junction dot is drawn where lines cross

boundary_check.rule: label boxes inside 1600x1100 with >= 8 px margin, and outside the title band (y<160) and the axis band (y>916)

annotation_text_check.rule: label boxes must not sit on axis ticks, captions, title or legend

association_check.rule: a label placed within 24 px (no leader) must be nearest to its own marker
